## Who is Kylian Mbappé?

Kylian Mbappé Lottin is a French professional footballer widely regarded as one of the best players of his generation. Renowned for his explosive pace, clinical finishing, and dribbling ability, he rose from the youth academy at AS Monaco to become a World Cup champion, a serial Ligue 1 title winner with Paris Saint-Germain, and — since the summer of 2024 — a Real Madrid forward.

He is the youngest Frenchman to score at a World Cup since Pelé, and in the 2022 World Cup final he became the first player since Geoff Hurst in 1966 to score a hat-trick in a World Cup final.

::: {.callout-quote}
"I have always dreamed big. When you dream, you have to dream big — otherwise it isn't worth dreaming at all." — Kylian Mbappé
:::
